name: vanguard-tech-radar
description: Track fresh technology trends, repos, models, research, events, and opportunities.
long_description: Vanguard Tech Radar is a local MCP server for surfacing high-signal technology trends, GitHub repositories, company announcements, Hugging Face models, arXiv research, developer opportunities, and daily actionable briefings.

tools.name: latest_tech_trends
tools.description: Get ranked, fresh technology trends from GitHub, Hacker News, and major company engineering/AI blogs.

tools.name: github_trending_repos
tools.description: Find high-signal GitHub repositories related to AI, agents, MCP, developer tools, and emerging tech.

tools.name: analyze_github_repo
tools.description: Analyze a GitHub repository using metadata, README excerpt, detected stack files, topics, and stars.

tools.name: repo_health_check
tools.description: Check GitHub repository maintenance health using recent commits, issue ratio, and latest release age.

tools.name: company_announcements
tools.description: Fetch recent announcements from major technology company blogs and developer feeds.

tools.name: developer_opportunities
tools.description: Surface opportunities such as hackathons, grants, accelerator programs, beta access, previews, and developer challenges.

tools.name: watch_new_tech_signals
tools.description: Return only newly seen technology signals using a local cache.

tools.name: analyze_tech_impact
tools.description: Explain why a trend or repo matters, what opportunities it unlocks, and who should care.

tools.name: models_and_research
tools.description: Find relevant Hugging Face models and arXiv research papers, with practical impact notes.

tools.name: daily_tech_briefing
tools.description: Create a daily radar briefing with top trends, repos, company announcements, models/research, opportunities, and recommended actions.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Optional token for higher GitHub API limits.
